project_info.theme: Lixibox Sundate Energy premium GWP promotion

prompt.generated_prompt_string: [COMBINED PROMPT]: High quality advertising poster for Lixibox Sundate Energy premium GWP promotion. Centerpiece is a woman in a brown swimsuit wearing a glowing pink LED face mask, posed poolside in bright daylight. Background is a luxury resort pool scene with blue water and warm stone deck. Surrounding elements: small white top-left header 'LIXIBOX GWP Gift with Purchase Sundate Energy', a blue gift box edge entering from bottom left, and large stacked offer text at lower right reading exactly 'Mua mặt nạ 6 triệu' and 'Nhận quà 7 triệu' with the second line in orange emphasis. Technical style: photorealistic advertising photography, natural sunlight, hard summer shadows and vivid pool reflections, 8k resolution, highly detailed.
